title.en: An Act Granting to the Oton Electric Company, Inc., a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power Plant in the Municipality of Oton, Province of Iloilo, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to the Oton Electric Company, Inc., for a period of fifty years from the
approval of this Act the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric current
service in the municipal of Oton, Province of Iloilo, Philippine Islands, either means of an electric plant
constructed within its municipal limits, or by means of electric current generated by a plant established outside
the municipality of Oton, for sale within the limits of said municipality, in the aforesaid Province of Iloilo,
Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1932.
